code:
$ ls -l orders.csv deploy.sh
-rw-r--r-- 1 mchen ops 48213 orders.csv
-rwxr-x--- 1 mchen ops  1024 deploy.sh
caption: Type, then owner/group/other rwx triplets, in that order.

code:
$ chmod u+x deploy.sh
$ chmod 750 deploy.sh
$ ls -l deploy.sh
-rwxr-x--- 1 mchen ops 1024 deploy.sh
caption: 750 = owner rwx (7), group r-x (5), other --- (0).

code:
$ sudo chown jramirez:ops orders.csv
$ ls -l orders.csv
-rw-r----- 1 jramirez ops 48213 orders.csv
caption: chown changes owner (and group, after the colon); chgrp changes group only.
